description: Presidential Secretariate - Once again enlarge the Commission of Inquiry up to 31st May 2023
reasoning: This gazette notification extends the deadline for a Commission of Inquiry to submit its final report, exercising powers under the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393). The content deals with legal procedures, statutory timelines, and the operation of a commission established through legal authority, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
